_comment: Mercedes-AMG G 63 with Urban Automotive styling, stock reference PT5654. Right-hand drive, model year 2026, built in Austria (both read off the car's own Mercedes-Benz build plate). Condition, mileage and price are deliberately left off the page (business instruction 2026-10-09), which is also why the brief carries no destinations: the per-destination heading names the car new or used. Engine, gearbox, 0-100 km/h, top speed, differential locks and AMG RIDE CONTROL are from mercedes-amg.com/en/g-class-suv, checked 2026-10-09. Urban Automotive equipment is listed only as it is visible in the photographs; urban-automotive.co.uk could not be read to confirm part names. Colour names are descriptive, not paint codes. Photographs are of this car, cropped to 16:10 for the car-page viewer and stored under public/cars/mercedes-amg-g63-urban-pt5654/; the two build-plate photos are left out because they show the full VIN. Each environment has its own database: recreate with node --env-file=.env.local scripts/create-car-page.mjs scripts/briefs/mercedes-amg-g63-urban-pt5654.json --env staging --publish (or --env production).

notes: This Mercedes-AMG G 63 Urban pairs a 430 kW V8 biturbo with Urban Automotive carbon-fibre styling, in right-hand drive from the 2026 model year. Carbon-fibre arches, bonnet vents, mirror caps, roof spoilers and spare-wheel cover sit over bronze Urban wheels, and the black-and-tan cabin carries UA honeycomb quilting. Under the styling is the standard G 63 drivetrain: the 4.0-litre V8 with 850 Nm, the nine-speed AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT 9G and three selectable differential locks. Stock reference PT5654.
